what: B back into the world (Continue, now online on S2); door at home; Create an invite (1 use) — a co-owner's link carries &o=

actions.eval: (async () => { const S = await import('/state/index.ts'); for (let i = 0; i < 80; i++) { const s = S.useSessionStore.getState(); if (s.screen === 'play' && s.activeInstance) return 'play'; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } return 'timeout ' + S.useSessionStore.getState().screen })()
(() => { const l = document.querySelector('[data-layer=door]'); if (!l) return 'no door'; const t = l.innerText; const at = t.indexOf('Sharing'); return t.slice(at, at + 700) })()

(async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) { const l = document.querySelector('[data-layer=door]'); const m = l && /unmapped:\/\/join\?i=[A-Za-z0-9_\-]+&k=[A-Za-z0-9_\-]+(&o=[A-Za-z0-9_\-]+)?/.exec([...l.querySelectorAll('input, textarea')].map(x => x.value).join('\n') + '\n' + l.innerText); if (m && !m[0].includes(window.__lastInvite ?? '§')) { window.__invite = m[0]; return m[0].length; } await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } return 'no link' })()

(() => { const l = document.querySelector('[data-layer=door]'); const links = [...l.querySelectorAll('input, textarea')].map(x => x.value).filter(v => v.startsWith('unmapped://join')); return JSON.stringify(links.map(v => ({ len: v.length, svc: JSON.parse(atob(v.split('i=')[1].split('&')[0].replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/'))).svc, o: v.includes('&o=') }))) })()
